rationale: Pre-seal amendment (round-23) section 'C2 final rules superseding only erroneous/ambiguous original clauses', ext2/3/4 clause: quota_state is ALWAYS unknown with enforcement n/a; if any quota-related option key is present the basis is ext_quota_option_unverified, otherwise ext_quota_superblock_unobservable is retained. Mount option hints and replay settings do not prove runtime accounting enabled, and S083 (Documentation/admin-guide/ext4.rst:261-265) states that the plain quota, noquota, grpquota and usrquota flags are ignored by the filesystem and are used only by quota tools to recognize volumes where quota should be turned on, so a visible usrquota key is a hint, not proof. Mount resolution (amendment, mount resolution clause; original contract section C2): mountinfo is parsed per proc.rst section 3.5 (S082, Documentation/filesystems/proc.rst:1965-1990), fields 1-6 are mount ID, parent ID, major:minor, root, mount point and per-mount options, optional 'tag[:value]' fields follow until the '-' separator, then filesystem type, mount source and super options, and the separator plus the last three fields are taken from each chosen line rather than file-wide. For realpath /srv/data the covering mount points are '/' (the ext4 root at 8:1), '/srv' (tmpfs at 0:41) and '/srv/data' (ext4 at 8:2); longest component-prefix selection keeps '/srv/data' (9 characters) over '/srv' (4) and '/' (1), and the same mount covers realpath /srv/data/projects/app by the component-prefix rule, so both paths report mount_point '/srv/data'. No covering mount point occurs more than once in this fixture, so the amendment's ambiguous_overmount refusal does not apply. Device rule (amendment, device mismatch clause): the chosen fstype is ext4, not btrfs, so the btrfs major-zero exemption does not apply; the mount major:minor 8:2 equals the path st_dev 8:2, so device_check is match and the mismatch preemption does not fire. Fixture source resolution (amendment): the raw decoded source of the chosen line is /dev/nvme0n1p4, which is absent from device_links, so basename(source) 'nvme0n1p4' would be compared against the UUID devices lists; this is inert here because the chosen fstype is not btrfs, and the btrfs_sysfs record is a decoy whose qgroups false pairs with qgroups_enabled null and qgroups_mode null as the amendment requires. Classification (amendment, ext clause, with the ext quota-related vocabulary extended by noquota and jqfmt): the super options of the chosen line are the last mountinfo field 'rw,usrquota', whose comma-split key 'usrquota' (text before '=') is quota-related and present, so both paths get quota_state unknown, enforcement n/a and basis ext_quota_option_unverified; supplementary device_check is match and quota_option_keys is the sorted quota-related key list ['usrquota'], with no option value, mount source or UUID emitted. Verdict precedence (original contract section C2): no setup error and no enabled path, at least one unknown path, so the run exits 2 with finding_id QUOTA_STATE_UNKNOWN.
